s.note: the elves running the huge Christmas Eve operation
s.how: Pop 100g popping corn and spread on a lined tray. Melt 200g white chocolate and drizzle all over, then scatter with red and green sprinkles and a pinch of sea salt. Leave to set for 30 minutes, then break into clusters for the mission team.

s.note: Grandsanta and his beloved old sleigh
s.how: Cut 3 sheets of shortcrust into rounds and press into a patty tin. Fill with fruit mince mixed with orange zest. Top each with a small pastry star, brush with beaten egg and bake at 190C for 18 minutes. Cool a little and dust with icing sugar.

m.note: Christmas dinner with the whole Claus family
m.how: Fry chopped bacon and onion with sage and breadcrumbs for a stuffing. Butterfly a 1.5kg turkey breast, spread with stuffing, roll and tie. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes with 1kg potatoes alongside. Serve sliced with roasted brussels sprouts and cranberry sauce.

w.how: Heat the Christmas pudding following the packet directions until hot right through. Warm 500ml custard gently with the finely grated zest of an orange and half a tsp vanilla extract, stirring, without boiling. Whip 300ml cream to soft peaks. Cut the pudding into thick slices, pour over the orange custard and top each with a spoon of cream and a little more zest.

d.note: the reindeer pulling the old sleigh
d.how: Whisk 4 egg yolks with 80g brown sugar in a pot. Stir in 600ml milk, 200ml cream, 1 tsp ground ginger, half a tsp cinnamon and a pinch of nutmeg. Heat gently, stirring all the time, until it coats the back of a spoon, about 8 minutes, without boiling. Strain and chill for 2 hours. Pour into glasses, top with whipped cream and crumble a gingernut biscuit over each.
